name: Switch
description: Toggle control with label placement, loading, and helper text.

dense: on/off toggle with immediate effect; label placement right/left/top, sm/md/lg, loading (aria-busy), own helperText + error; onCheckedChange(boolean)

usage.description: Switch is an on/off toggle whose effect applies immediately, like enabling dark mode or notifications. It renders a real button with role=switch, supports label placement, a loading state for async flips, and carries its own helper and error text.

bestPractices.description: Use Switch only when flipping it takes effect immediately; a choice submitted later is a Checkbox.
Label the thing being controlled (Email notifications), never the current state (On).
Use loading while an async toggle is in flight; it sets aria-busy and blocks double flips.
Use helperText for consequences worth knowing before flipping (Applies to all devices).
Do not use a Switch inside a submitted form for consent; that is Checkbox territory.
Do not use negative labels (Disable sounds); keep the label positive so on means yes.
